## Overview

In statistics, **Markov chain Monte Carlo** (**MCMC**) is a class of algorithms
used to draw samples from a probability distribution. Given a probability
distribution, one can construct a [[markov-chains|Markov chain]] whose
elements' distribution approximates it - that is, the Markov chain's
[[markov-chain-equilibrium-convergence|equilibrium distribution]] matches the
target distribution. The more steps that are included, the more closely the
distribution of the sample matches the actual desired distribution.
